title: Concept: Cron schedule exposed in a response
description: A crontab listing with job times and commands in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The schedule names the batch jobs, their run times and the scripts they call, which is the timing an attacker needs to interfere with settlement or reconciliation windows.
applicability: Deployments that render a crontab listing with job times and commands into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The schedule names the batch jobs, their run times and the scripts they call, which is the timing an attacker needs to interfere with settlement or reconciliation windows.
